2012 Copa Bolivia | The 2012 season of the Copa Bolívia is the first edition of the third tier of the Bolivian Football pyramid.  In this edition will comprise the runners-up of the nine regional championship, the runners-up of Torneo Nacional Interprovincial 2012 and two invited teams.  The host cities are Tarija and Warnes.
